overview: Arim, Alma, Samr and Deem have different home designs and release schedules. This page covers the master community rather than one sales cluster.
The April 2026 construction award includes the final residential clusters, mall, clubhouse and public spaces; an award is not evidence of completion.
research.locationNote: Emirates Road, Barashi, Sharjah. Select the exact neighbourhood and plot on the approved master plan.
research.priceNote: Property Finder retains an AED 1.9 million launch guide. No current developer price for the whole community was verified.
research.paymentNote: Historical Deem example only: 5% booking, 5% after 30 days, twelve quarterly 2.5% instalments, 60% completion. Current phase terms require confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The current dashboard shows June 2030 for Hayyan. Earlier releases targeted end-2026 for Arim and September 2028 for Samr 1; these are different scopes, not completion certificates.
